## How it works

Android TVs have the same debug bridge as Android phones. Switch on USB debugging in the TV's
developer options, allow your computer once, and the rest is standard Android tooling:

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Back up** | The list of installed packages and settings. |
| **Disable** | The manufacturer's telemetry, ad services, content rows and preloaded junk, with `pm disable-user`. Nothing is uninstalled, so a restore script can undo every step. |
| **Install** | A small native launcher, made the default home screen. |

**No root, no cable, nothing uninstalled, and a one-line restore if you change your mind.**

The bloat differs by brand, so the prompt has your coding assistant discover it on your TV and ask
before touching anything you might use.

## Quick start

| You have | Do this |
|---|---|
| **A computer** | Use the prompt with a coding assistant: the three steps below. |
| **A computer, no coding assistant** | Run the three steps yourself: the commands are in [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand). |
| **Only an Android phone** | Use the community-built [Clean Your TV app](https://cleanyour.tv/app) by [@udhaykumarbala](https://github.com/udhaykumarbala): connect, analyse, clean, in about five minutes. No laptop, no coding agent. |

The three steps below are written for a coding assistant: the computer needs to be on the same Wi-Fi as
the TV, with a shell on it. Without an assistant, [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand) is the same job,
run by you.

Any of these work: Claude Code (on [0G Private Computer](https://pc.0g.ai/?utm_source=cleanyourtv&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme) or an [Anthropic plan](https://claude.com/pricing)), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) or [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli).

| Where | What to do |
|---|---|
| **1. On the TV** | Settings → Device Preferences → About → press OK on **Build** seven times → back → Developer options → **USB debugging** on. If you see a Network or ADB debugging toggle, turn that on too. Keep the TV on. |
| **2. On your computer** | Clone the repo and open that folder in your assistant (`git clone https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv`), then paste [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and fill in your TV model. |
| **3. Follow along** | Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV, then answer the checklist: which apps you use, the dock size and app order, whether to keep the voice assistant, Chromecast and updates. |

Cloning matters: the assistant reuses this repo's `tools/disable.sh` and `launcher/build-and-install.sh`
instead of writing its own, and that is where the backup, the Home guard and the restore record live.

The assistant backs up, debloats, builds and installs the launcher, and checks each step with
screenshots pulled from the TV. With this repo as context it takes about fifteen minutes.

## What you get

A home screen that looks like an Apple TV and gets out of the way:

| Part | What it looks like |
|---|---|
| **A pitch-black home** | A dock of your four favourite apps in a rounded band, where Apple TV puts it. |
| **A top shelf** | Names the focused app in large type, with an ambient glow in a colour taken from its artwork. |
| **The rest of your apps in a grid** | Slides up when you press Down. |
| **One floating glass highlight** | Springs from tile to tile. The focused tile lifts and shows its name. |
| **Three frosted buttons** | Inputs (HDMI ports under the names you gave them in the TV's settings, AV, Live TV), Wi-Fi or Ethernet with the network name, Settings. |
| **A greeting, a thin clock and the date** | In [Outfit](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Outfit), and a matching Clock screensaver. Set `show_stats` in config or a theme for one line under the clock: CPU, free memory and free storage. It stays off unless you turn it on, and it refreshes only while Home is on screen. |
| **Themes and module cards** | Themes change colours, wallpaper, dock and columns without a rebuild, and module cards let other apps plug a tile in, only with your say-so. |

And a TV that stops working against you: no sponsored rows, no "Discover" nags, no analytics
phoning home, no apps you never asked for.

oss.description: Your GeForce runs AI at half speed. This fixes it for 20/30/40 series cards. Up to 2× FP16 / BF16 / TF32 tensor throughput
oss.readme:
![gpu-unlock: full-speed tensor cores for GeForce RTX](assets/banner.svg)

### Your GeForce runs AI at half speed. This fixes it.

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-2.0.0-76b900)![RTX 20 | 30 | 40](https://img.shields.io/badge/GeForce-RTX%2020%20%7C%2030%20%7C%2040-76b900?logo=nvidia&logoColor=white)![Linux](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Linux-informational?logo=linux&logoColor=white)![License GPL-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--2.0-blue)![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Zagitta/gpu-unlock?style=flat&color=yellow)

**Up to 2× FP16 / BF16 / TF32 tensor throughput** · **+25–55% LLM prefill** · **+25–50% fine-tuning** · **+30–55% image generation**

[Supported GPUs](#supported-gpus) · [Benchmarks](#what-you-get) · [Install](#how-to-install) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Support](#support-me)

---

NVIDIA ships GeForce cards with their tensor cores capped to **half speed** for
FP16, BF16 and TF32 math with FP32 accumulation, which is what nearly all AI
training and unquantized inference uses. The same silicon sold as an RTX A-series
or professional card runs at full rate. `gpu_unlock` removes that cap at boot,
before the stock NVIDIA driver loads. No patched driver, no VBIOS flash, nothing
to redo when NVIDIA releases a new driver.

---

## Supported GPUs

| Generation                | Cards                                                                                                                  | Status                    |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| **Ampere** (RTX 30)       | RTX 3050, 3060, 3060 Ti, 3070, 3070 Ti, 3080, 3080 Ti, 3090, 3090 Ti, plus RTX 3070/3080 Laptop GPUs                   | Stable, 100+ user reports |
| **Ada Lovelace** (RTX 40) | RTX 4060, 4060 Ti, 4070, 4070 SUPER, 4070 Ti, 4070 Ti SUPER, 4080, 4080 SUPER, 4090, 4090 D, RTX 4050/4060 Laptop GPUs | Experimental              |
| **Turing** (RTX 20)       | RTX 2060, 2060 SUPER, 2070, 2070 SUPER, 2080, 2080 SUPER, 2080 Ti, Titan RTX                                           | Experimental              |
| Blackwell (RTX 50)        |                                                                                                                        | Not supported             |

Laptops only stay unlocked if the dedicated GPU is never fully powered off.  
Many laptops power it down when idle, which silently resets the unlock. Turning  
off runtime power management with `options nvidia NVreg_DynamicPowerManagement=0x00`
in `/etc/modprobe.d/` helps on some models, but expect mixed results.

The exact PCI device IDs are in [`kernel/gpu_unlock/recipes.c`](kernel/gpu_unlock/recipes.c).
Linux only. For Windows see the [FAQ](#faq).

---

## What you get

The tensor core rate doubles. How much of that you see depends on how much of
your workload is FP16/BF16/TF32 matrix math, and on whether the card has the
power headroom to run it.

Dense matrix multiply (FP32 accumulation, stock power limits):

| Card | BF16 before | BF16 after | Gain |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RTX 3060 12 GB | 27 TFLOPS | 51 TFLOPS | +87% |
| RTX 3060 Ti | 37 TFLOPS | 68 TFLOPS | +82% |
| RTX 3070 | 40 TFLOPS | 72 TFLOPS | +81% |
| RTX 3080 10 GB | 65 TFLOPS | 113 TFLOPS | +73% |
| RTX 3090 | 75 TFLOPS | 125 TFLOPS | +65% |
| RTX 3090 Ti (450 W) | 88 TFLOPS | 157 TFLOPS | +80% |
| RTX 4070 Ti | 81 TFLOPS | 150 TFLOPS | +84% |
| RTX 4080 | 104 TFLOPS | 193 TFLOPS | +87% |
| RTX 4090 | 165 TFLOPS | 329 TFLOPS | +100% (peak MMA rate) |

The RTX 4090 runs out of power before it runs out of tensor cores, so large
GEMMs at stock power limits gain much less than the peak rate suggests.

Real workloads:

| Workload | Typical speedup |
| --- | --- |
| LLM prefill / prompt processing, FP16/BF16 or AWQ/GPTQ (vLLM, PyTorch, Transformers) | +25–55% |
| Time to first token | 25–30% lower |
| LoRA and full fine-tuning in BF16 | +25–50% |
| Image generation, FP16/BF16 (SDXL, SD 1.5, Krea, DiT models in ComfyUI) | +30–55% |
| Video generation, BF16 compute (Wan 2.2) | +15–20% |
| FlashAttention / SDPA kernels | +50–60% |
| llama.cpp / Ollama with quantized GGUF | 0–15%, mostly at long context |
| LLM decode / token generation (memory bound) | No change |
| INT8, FP8 and INT4 models | No change |
| Gaming and FP32 CUDA | No change |

Outputs are bit-identical before and after; only the speed changes. These
numbers come from the [compatibility reports](https://github.com/Zagitta/gpu-unlock/issues)
users have filed, where you can find full benchmark details and post your own.

---

## How to install

First run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Zagitta/gpu-unlock
cd gpu-unlock
make install
```

Then append `gpu_unlock.targets=all` to your kernel command line, keeping
existing options:

- **GRUB (Debian/Ubuntu/Mint):** add it inside `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT`
in `/etc/default/grub`, then run `sudo update-grub`.
- **GRUB (Arch/CachyOS):** same edit, then run
`sudo grub-mkconfig -o /boot/grub/grub.cfg`.
- **Fedora/RHEL:** run
`sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="gpu_unlock.targets=all"`.
- **systemd-boot:** append it to the `options` line in your boot entry
(`bootctl status` shows its location).
- **UKI / generated entries:** add it to `/etc/kernel/cmdline` and regenerate
your boot images/entries (e.g. `sudo mkinitcpio -P` for mkinitcpio UKIs).

# ub-mode

`ub-mode` is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on portions of [@poteto](https://github.com/poteto)'s rules (`poteto-mode` / `pstack`), reduced and paired with deterministic quality-gate tools:

1. **First Make it Work** — Laziness Protocol, Foundational Thinking, TDD, Redesign From First Principles, Attack the Premise, Subtract Before You Add, Outcome-Oriented Execution, Build the Lever, and Architecture (Model the Domain, Boundary Discipline, Type System Discipline, Make Operations Idempotent, Separate Before Serializing Shared State).
2. **Then Make it Right** — Fix Root Causes, Sequence Work into Verifiable Units, Test Behavior (Not Implementation), [Crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) (`CRAP = 0.8` similarity) are eliminated.
- [unclebob/mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) — Runs mutation testing to expose uncovered code and surviving mutants that tests fail to catch.
- [unclebob/uml-viewer](https://github.com/unclebob/uml-viewer) — Visualizes components, coverage, CRAP, mutation scores, and dependency directions.

## Installation

Copy `SKILL.md` into your agent's skills directory as `ub-mode/SKILL.md` (for example `~/.grok/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, `~/.claude/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, or `~/.cursor/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`), then invoke `/ub-mode`.

# Aerial

**给国产电视的一块干净桌面。**

参照 Apple TV 做的 Android TV 桌面：没有广告，没有推荐流，只有你的 App、壁纸和航拍屏保。
适合小米、TCL、创维、索尼等国产电视，也能装在盒子和投影仪上。开机自动进入，待机也不会被清理。

**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

![Aerial 首页](site/img/home.jpg)

| 电视自带的桌面 | 换上 Aerial 之后 |
|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |

## 功能

  
  

- **首页**：常用的一排 App 放在屏幕下方的玻璃底板上，往下是全部 App。小米「应用中心」「米家」这类藏起来的系统 App 也在。
- **整理**：长按 OK 键（或按菜单键）可以移动、放进文件夹、隐藏、卸载，或者设成「开机时打开」（开机、待机醒来直接进这个 App 或信号源）。固定到主屏幕的 HDMI 可以选接的是 Apple TV、PlayStation、Switch、Xbox、电脑等，换成对应的图标，也能在手机上起名字。
- **用手机整理**：扫电视上的二维码，手机上就是和电视一样的图标网格：按住拖动排序，点一下改名、换图标、放进文件夹或隐藏，也能把 HDMI 等信号源加到主屏幕。
- **控制中心**：在第一排按上键到右上角打开，有信号源、网络、设置、音量、亮度和个性化。
- **屏保**：Apple TV 的 114 段航拍影片，电视支持时播 4K 或 4K 杜比视界，也可以换成照片、时钟或从手机添加的本地视频（[说明](docs/SCREENSAVER_VIDEOS.md)）。
- **壁纸**：必应每日精选、14 张内置壁纸、用手机扫码传的照片和视频，或者航拍：停在主屏幕 10 秒后在磁贴后面播放，按任意键停在当前画面。
- **个性化**：每排 4、5 或 6 个 App，单排或双排、时钟大小和位置、App 名称、焦点样式、按键声音，都能改。

  
  

  
  

## 安装

不用 root，不动系统应用，随时能还原。电脑和电视连同一个网络。

### 1. 打开电视的 ADB 调试

| 电视 | 怎么打开 |
|---|---|
| **小米 / Redmi** | 设置 → 关于 → 连续按「产品型号/产品类型」进入开发者模式，再到 设置 → 账号与安全，打开「ADB 调试」和「安装未知来源的应用」 |
| **TCL / 雷鸟** | 设置 → 关于 → 本机信息，快速按遥控器「上下左右」，在底部的「更多」里打开 ADB |
| **海尔 / 模卡** | 按电视机身上的信号源键，再用遥控器按「左左上右」，在工厂菜单里打开「ADB 调试开关」，别动其他选项 |
| **OPPO（含 S1）** | 设置 → 系统 → 关于本机 → 设备型号，按「上上右右」再按确认；再到 设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项，打开「USB 调试」。IP 在 设置 → 网络 → 已连接的网络 最下面 |
| **其他 Android TV** | 设置 → 设备偏好设置 → 关于 → 连按「内部版本号」7 次，再在开发者选项里打开「USB 调试」 |

电视的 IP 在「设置 → 网络 → 已连接的网络」里。第一次连接时，有 USB 调试开关的电视会问是否允许调试，选「始终允许」；只有无线调试的电视不弹这个窗，见下一段。

**只有无线调试、没有 USB 调试 / 网络调试（ADB 调试）开关的 Android 11+ 电视，第一次要先配对**（例如索尼 BRAVIA 的 Android 14，#747）：这类电视不提供旧的明文端口，不能直接 `adb connect :5555`。在电视上打开 设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项 → **无线调试** → **使用配对码配对设备**，把配对码屏幕上的 IP:端口和 6 位配对码输入电脑：

```bash
adb pair 192.168.1.20:37115   # 电视配对码屏幕上的端口（示例，以电视显示为准）
# 提示 Enter pairing code 时输入电视上的 6 位配对码
adb connect 192.168.1.20:39201   # 无线调试主页面上的另一组 IP:端口（示例）
```

连上后照常安装。想让以后直接用 `:5555`，连上时再运行一次 `adb tcpip 5555`；配过对的电脑不用再配对。`install.sh` 和[安装说明](site/agent.md)里的 Agent 会引导这一步。部分 TCL 固件（Q10M、Q10L、鹤 6 Ultra 等）没有配对码入口，只能先按下面的分品牌说明用数据线连电脑授权。

更细的分品牌说明（包括打不开 ADB 的机型）见 [docs/devices/adb-by-brand.md](docs/devices/adb-by-brand.md)。

### 2. 安装

**让 Agent 装（推荐）**：把下面这段发给能在电脑上运行命令的 Agent（WorkBuddy、豆包电脑版、千问电脑版、Trae、Claude Code、Codex 等）：

```text
请帮我把开源电视桌面 Aerial 装到我的电视上，并设为开机进入的桌面。
电视 IP：
保持 ADB 常开：要

安装说明在这里：https://aerial.qust.me/agent.md
（打不开时用 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pengchujin/aerial-tv/main/site/agent.md ）

请先完整读完安装说明再动手，然后在我的电脑上亲自运行命令，不要只把步骤告诉我。需要我在电视上操作时提醒我。
最后按说明里的「验收」，把这几条命令的原始输出原样贴给我：
- adb shell "cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME"
- adb shell settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services
- 按主页键后的 adb shell "dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus"
```

**没有电脑**：有用户用手机上的甲壳虫 ADB 助手、超级小爱装成功过，本仓库没有逐一实测。步骤和上面的 Windows 步骤一样，装好后建议再用电脑跑一遍验收。

**一行命令（macOS / Linux）**：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://aerial.qust.me/install.sh | KEEP_ADB=1 TV=192.168.1.20 bash
```

只有无线调试的电视（见第 1 步）先 `export ADB_PAIR= ADB_CODE= ADB_CONNECT=`，再跑上面的命令；没有配对码入口的（TCL Q10M、Q10L、鹤 6 Ultra 等）先按[分品牌说明](docs/devices/adb-by-brand.md)用数据线连一次、运行 `adb tcpip 5555`，之后照常跑上面的命令。

**手动**：下载 [aerial-standard.apk](https://aerial.qust.me/download/aerial-standard.apk)。只有无线调试的电视（见第 1 步）按下面两种情况之一先处理好，再运行命令：

- **有配对码入口**（索尼 BRAVIA 的 Android 14 等）：按第 1 步配对，连上后运行一次 `adb tcpip 5555`，命令的第一行才用 5555；不运行的话，第一行换成无线调试主页面的 IP:端口，其余不变。
- **没有配对码入口**（TCL Q10M、Q10L、鹤 6 Ultra 等）：按[分品牌说明](docs/devices/adb-by-brand.md)用数据线把电视连到电脑，授权后运行一次 `adb tcpip 5555`；没走这一步时，命令第一行的 `adb connect :5555` 不适用。

```bash
adb connect 192.168.1.20:5555
adb install -r aerial-standard.apk
adb shell pm grant app.orchard.tv android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
adb shell cmd notification allow_listener app.orchard.tv/app.orchard.tv.guard.RevivalListener
adb shell appops set app.orchard.tv SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
adb shell am start -n app.orchard.tv/.MainActivity
```

Windows 用 Agent 装，或照[安装说明](site/agent.md)里的 Windows 步骤。

**U 盘（不用电脑）**：下载 APK 拷进 U 盘，用电视的文件管理器打开安装。

| 下载 | 用在 |
|---|---|
| [aerial-standard.apk](https://aerial.qust.me/download/aerial-standard.apk) | Android 5.0 及以上，先装这个 |
| [aerial-guard.apk](https://aerial.qust.me/download/aerial-guard.apk) | standard 装不上、提示不允许安装桌面类 App 时 |
| [aerial-lite.apk](https://aerial.qust.me/download/aerial-lite.apk) | Android 4.0–4.4（见下面的 [Aerial Lite](#lite)） |

装好后按主页键：系统问「使用哪个应用」时选 Aerial、再选「始终」就设好了（原生 Android TV 一般是这样）。直接回到原桌面、不问（国产电视大多这样）时，从「我的应用」打开 Aerial，它会弹出「设为主屏幕」，按里面的入口去电视设置里打开桌面守护（无障碍）和通知使用权；电视设置里没有这些入口时，Aerial 只能当普通 App 用，要接管主页键还得用上面的命令或 Agent 设置一次（覆盖安装，不丢设置）。

**升级**：1.32 起，有新版本时控制中心会出现「有新版本」，点进去选「下载并安装」，在电视自己的安装界面确认（小米、TCL 上验证过），装完回到 Aerial，设置都保留。电视不让 App 安装应用时，升级就是再运行一次安装命令：升级页上有二维码，手机扫码能直接复制这台电视的命令，或者交给 Agent。1.31 及以前没有这个按钮，这一次还是要再运行一次安装命令。

### Android 4.0–4.4 老电视：Aerial Lite（测试版）

Android 4.0–4.4 的老电视、老盒子装不了完整版（界面框架最低要 Android 5.0），所以有一个单独的 **Aerial Lite**：包名 `app.orchard.tv.lite`，外观和完整版一样。

> **Lite 现在是第一版（1.0），属于测试版。** 只在 Android 4.0.4 / 4.4.4 虚拟机，以及小米、TCL 的新电视上测过，还没在真实的 4.x 电视上用过，可能有不少小问题。**只适配 Android 4.0–4.4**；Android 5.0 及以上请用上面的完整版。遇到问题请用[机型适配模板](https://github.com/pengchujin/aerial-tv/issues/new?template=device.yml)反馈，标题写上 Lite。

**一行命令（macOS / Linux）**：和完整版是同一条命令，脚本发现电视是 Android 4.x 会自动装 Lite；也可以明确指定：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://aerial.qust.me/install.sh | TV=192.168.1.20 bash -s lite
```

**手动**：下载 [aerial-lite.apk](https://aerial.qust.me/download/aerial-lite.apk)，然后：

```bash
adb connect 192.168.1.20:5555
adb install -r aerial-lite.apk
adb shell pm grant app.orchard.tv.lite android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS   # 调亮度用；Android 4.0 会报错，可以忽略
adb shell am start -n app.orchard.tv.lite/.HomeActivity
```

**U 盘**：把 `aerial-lite.apk` 拷进 U 盘，用电视的文件管理器打开安装。

**装好以后**：按遥控器的**主页键**，系统问「使用哪个应用」时选 **Aerial Lite**，再选「**始终**」。不弹出选择、直接回到原桌面，说明固件把主页键锁在了自家桌面，这时只能从应用列表打开 Lite。

- Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the VS Code extension
- Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place
- Fixed per-directory and `paths:` skills not being found after a Bash `cd` deeper into a git repository
- Fixed a rare case where the first reply after resuming a session in the terminal could be missing the next time the session was resumed
- Fixed a command with an invalid name stopping all commands from loading, which could leave `claude -p` with no output
- Fixed the Read tool sometimes failing on PDF pages with "pdftoppm failed: Could not write image" when the clean-up of old session files ran at the same time
- Fixed the spinner, OpenTelemetry `effort` values and transcripts naming a newly picked effort level during a task before the model applied it; they now show the level in force
- Fixed the `/model` and `/effort` cache warning saying the re-read waits for your next message; a change made while Claude is working can trigger it sooner
- Fixed some sessions showing as waiting on you when the last message only mentioned items waiting on you mid-sentence

- Improved the prompt's effort indicator: a change made mid-task now says it may wait for your next message, and the note clears when it no longer applies
- Improved WebFetch errors in cloud sessions: a host that does not resolve is now explained as possibly outside the allowed network domains, so Claude names the host to allow

releases.name: wrangler@4.155.0
releases.body:
### Minor Changes

- [#16536](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16536) [`a95d647`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/a95d647f9459e40a00871346b81082abbb27d2b3) Thanks [@WalshyDev](https://github.com/WalshyDev)! - Support remote Analytics Engine bindings in local development

  Setting `remote: true` on an Analytics Engine dataset now sends `writeDataPoint()` calls from `wrangler dev` and the Vite plugin to the real dataset. Without it, writes are still dropped locally.

  ```jsonc
  {
    "analytics_engine_datasets": [
      {
        "binding": "EVENTS",
        "dataset": "my-dataset",
        "remote": true
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### Patch Changes

- [#16526](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16526) [`dba0e81`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/dba0e81501d3900907a6377dd88a153bb5139d37) Thanks [@petebacondarwin](https://github.com/petebacondarwin)! - Render terminal control characters as visible text in tail output

  Pretty tail and remote-preview output now escape control characters in log strings, exceptions and event metadata. Unicode, tabs and multiline logs remain readable, and JSON output keeps the original structured values.

- [#16489](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16489) [`fc57bc0`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/fc57bc0e03b096cff58e949e67ccfb9f7832a3c2) Thanks [@akshitsinha](https://github.com/akshitsinha)! - Keep Flagship flag metadata when updating flags

  `wrangler flagship flags` commands that update an existing flag, such as `enable`, `set`, `rollout`, `split`, and `rules`, no longer clear the flag's metadata. `wrangler flagship flags pull` now copies metadata into the local flag store.

- [#16521](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16521) [`ec6eddd`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/ec6edddadd8395b4991b23c5300ea68b701ce720) Thanks [@petebacondarwin](https://github.com/petebacondarwin)! - Validate `.assetsignore` encoding before building asset manifests

  Asset uploads and local development now stop with an actionable user error when `.assetsignore` is not valid UTF-8 or contains null characters, instead of silently losing its patterns. This also applies to standalone Miniflare and the Wrangler, Vite and Vitest development integrations. Save the file as UTF-8 to continue; UTF-8 files with a byte order mark and intentionally empty files remain supported.
